title: LitMundi Translation Gap Atlas — bounded evidence survey
purpose: Separate documented competing editions from unverified absence, access, quality and demand hypotheses. This research does not authorize publication.

second_language_decision.rationale: Indonesian offers inspectable national/public-library records and active literary publishers, enabling a meaningful comparator. No qualified reviewer capacity or superior unmet demand was verified.
approval_conditions: A bounded bibliography review establishes a specific access, completeness or reuse need.
Two independent bilingual literary reviewers explicitly agree to the selected source-language pair.
Observe reader demand before committing production.

methodology.coverage: 20 named works and 40 work-language assessments; web-indexed catalogs, national bibliographies, publishers, translator publications and original-source witnesses.
limitations: This is a reproducible first-pass survey, not a comprehensive bibliographic census. Most negative searches used public web indexes, not complete internal national-library catalogs.
Search results may be stale; access methods and failures are recorded in source records. Dynamic inventory or search counters are not demand measurements.
No claim of nonexistent translation, unavailable translation, independently proven inadequate translation or globally cleared rights is made.
No reader study, human reviewer recruitment or human literary certification was completed by this survey.

confidence_definition.high: Positive item-level metadata or credited translation; confidence applies to existence only.
confidence_definition.medium: Named edition, research or collection evidence with unresolved attribution or coverage.
confidence_definition.low: Bounded search did not establish an edition; no confidence in absence.

methodology.verified_gap_requirement: At least two named bibliographic sources, documented scope and search variants, plus attributable human specialist verification. Empty search results alone cannot receive verified_gap.
methodology.quality_requirement: An inadequate_translation claim requires a version-specific independent bilingual assessment, errors and review evidence; none is asserted here.
